tier: runtime: every valid call from any storage the spec admits; constructor establishment, preservation by every entrypoint and reentrant post-states are not stated (lifecycle tier: BLOCKED)

default.reason: unclassified source feature: not in the supported envelope

features.title: One-level mappings with uint256 values
features.premise: Keccak-256 separation scoped to each call's footprint (ScopedSep), stated inside spec.Valid at the call; or a named HashInj assumption (conditional tier). Never a global separation premise.

features.reason: mappings whose values are not uint256 (such as mapping(address => bool)): Generic.eraseFn gives no tree (generic driver probe: Registry)

nested mappings: only slot-level and key-level results under scoped separation exist (Contracts/UniswapV2/ERC20/Nested), no end-to-end certificate; a global NestedSlotsSeparated premise is not accepted

features.title: Checked +, -, * and comparisons, with Panic(0x11) on overflow
features.evidence: Certified/counter (Panic 0x11 in allowed), Certified/mulx, transfer's SafeMath reverts

features.reason: division, modulo, exponentiation, bitwise operators and shifts: no certified contract exercises them end to end

features.title: unchecked blocks with wrapping + and -
features.evidence: transfer: the port of SafeMath.add/sub (unchecked, then require) is in the certified scope

features.reason: wrapping multiplication in unchecked blocks: no certified contract exercises it

features.title: emit of events with value-type fields (LOG0-LOG4)
Calls of internal and private functions, and internal library functions (using-for)
features.evidence: Certified/bank (compiled), transfer's _transfer and SafeMath (checker with contexts, AssembleCtx)

features.reason: a public function called internally: Generic.eraseFn gives no tree (generic driver probe: Band)
recursive internal calls: the checker with contexts types each internal function once per call site; no recursion support

loops: the generic source stage (Generic.eraseFn/check) is loop-free, so supplied invariants have no generic consumer yet; loop certificates exist only on contract-specific routes (Contracts/VerifyCounter, Contracts/CallSqrt). The gate also blocks a loop without a supplied invariant/ranking certificate
features.evidence: generic driver probe at solar 902cccc2 / solidity-lean bc6da61b (StepSum, EmptyRevert)

features.reason: calls to other contracts or accounts (external, low-level call/delegatecall/staticcall, transfer/send): Expected runs the source in a closed world; the open-world shape (Shapes.OpenFunctional) is never Certified
reentrancy: needs external calls and the actual post-state of a reentrant call; not stated
contract creation (new C, CREATE): source and assembly nodes exist (CreateNode, AssembleCreate) but no certificate composes them
salted creation (new C{salt: s}, CREATE2): not certified end to end
memory array allocation: not certified

features.title: Constant gas bound per valid call, below 2^64
features.premise: observable-equality bound: from the bound on, the bytes' observable equals the source's; an empty revert is not told apart from out-of-gas, so this is not a no-out-of-gas guarantee

features.title: Constructors without parameters
features.premise: runtime tier only: the init code is not covered and valid calls range over any storage the spec admits (storage that writes the constructor's slots); constructor establishment of the spec's invariant is not stated

features.reason: constructors with parameters: Wide.DeployedAt runs the constructor with no arguments, so no generic route reaches a deployed state (generic driver probe: Clamp, StepSum)
lifecycle certificate (constructor establishes the invariant, every entrypoint preserves it, reentrant post-states): not provided; Expected is the runtime tier
immutable variables: their values are patched into the runtime bytes by the constructor; not modelled
constant state variables: Generic.eraseFn gives no tree for functions reading them (generic driver probe: Band)
inline assembly: not certified (assembly create2 has a source node only)
custom errors: no certified contract
try/catch: external calls
payable functions accepting value: no certified contract (a call with value to a non-payable function is supported and reverts)
fallback and receive functions: not certified
dynamic ABI types (string, bytes, arrays, structs) in parameters or returns: valid calls are clean static argument words only
structs, arrays, strings and bytes in storage: no certified contract
inheriting from a contract with code: no certified contract (inheriting interfaces only is accepted)
public/external library functions (DELEGATECALL to a linked library)
selfdestruct

features.title: msg.sender
features.premise: the statement covers the contexts in spec.Contexts (a caller parameter); coverage is reported, and a single-caller coverage is never reported as any-caller

features.reason: msg.value, msg.data and msg.sig reads: not certified

features.title: block.* and tx.* reads
features.premise: the block and transaction are Target.message's fixed values, recorded in coverage, not quantified

features.title: keccak256 and abi.encode of value types
features.premise: EthLib's Keccak-256 on both sides; no injectivity assumed by the translation (Certified/abi_hash, compiled)

features.reason: other builtins (ecrecover, sha256, ripemd160, addmod, mulmod, gasleft, blockhash, abi.decode, abi.encodePacked, abi.encodeWithSelector, ...)
